title: Moving the cursor and single click
drDigitalIntro:
Let's practice two skills: moving the cursor and clicking.
• Slide one fingertip on the trackpad to move the cursor — or move your mouse.
• Tap the trackpad once (or click the left mouse button) to select something.
• Press down until you feel a soft click if you want a firmer click.
• In the game, move the cursor to a falling shape and click it.

playgroundTask.instructions: Click each falling shape before it reaches the bottom. New ones keep dropping!

drDigitalSuccess: Fantastic clicking! You've got moving the cursor and single-clicking down.
drDigitalHint: Move your finger on the trackpad (or move your mouse) to steer the cursor, then tap (or left-click) to score. Keep clicking until you reach the target!
